name: Lorelei Weber
source:
Spokesperson for Next Horizons and a highly respected public figure, Lorelei Weber has built her career on advocating for HUBs and reducing inequality with scions. Her unconventional appearance and the unstable nature of her ability have forced her to make self-control an essential part of her public image.
When she uses her power, her physical abilities are amplified beyond human limits, while her rational mind is overwhelmed by an instinctive and uncontrollable state.
